name: co.bindler/regulatory-calculators
title: Bindler: UAE Corporate Tax, CSRD scope, EU AI Act, CBAM and statutory deadlines
description: UAE Corporate Tax, CSRD scope, EU AI Act, CBAM cost and statutory deadlines, each citing its law

tools.name: uae_corporate_tax
tools.description: Use it when someone asks: how much corporate tax will my Dubai or UAE company pay, what is the rate on my profit, is the first AED 375,000 really tax free, is it 9 per cent on everything, do I qualify for Small Business Relief and is it worth electing, am I a Qualifying Free Zone Person, is my free zone income really 0 per cent, does the de minimis test take away my 0 per cent, how much of my interest expense is deductible, can I offset last year's tax loss, what is my taxable income after adjustments. Computes the tax payable for one Tax Period from the caller's own figures under Federal Decree-Law 47 of 2022, line by line with the Article behind each line: Small Business Relief, the 0 per cent band, the 9 per cent rate, QFZP and de minimis, the Article 30 interest cap with the AED 12,000,000 safe harbour, and Article 37 loss relief capped at 75 per cent. A computation, not an estimate.

accounting_income.description: Accounting income for the period, AED.

revenue.description: Revenue for the period, AED. Small Business Relief needs this at or below 3,000,000.

elect_small_business_relief.description: Whether the election under Article 21 is made. Default false, so you see the tax with and without it.

non_qualifying_revenue.description: For the Free Zone de minimis test, AED.

is_bank_or_insurance.description: Exempt from the Article 30 interest limitation.

tools.name: eu_ai_act_classify
tools.description: Use it when someone asks: is my AI system high risk, does the EU AI Act apply to my chatbot, to my hiring or CV screening tool, to our credit scoring model, what risk category are we in, what are my obligations and when do they start, am I a provider or a deployer, does it apply to a US company selling into the EU, do we have to register in the EU database, what is the fine if we get this wrong, is this banned, must we tell users they are talking to an AI, must we label AI generated content or deep fakes, what applies to a general purpose AI model. Classifies a system under Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 from the caller's description and returns the risk class, the obligations with article numbers, the date they apply and the fine ceiling. The Annex III list, the Article 6(3) exemption and the staggered application dates are the parts most often got wrong.

role.description: Provider, Deployer, Importer or Distributor. Default Provider.

prohibited_practice.description: One of: None | 5(1)(a) Manipulative or deceptive techniques | 5(1)(b) Exploiting vulnerabilities | 5(1)(c) Social scoring | 5(1)(d) Predictive policing on profiling alone | 5(1)(e) Untargeted facial scraping | 5(1)(f) Workplace or school emotion inference | 5(1)(g) Sensitive biometric categorisation | 5(1)(h) Real-time remote biometric ID for law enforcement. Default None.

annex_iii_use_case.description: One of: None | 1(a) Remote biometric identification | 1(b) Biometric categorisation by sensitive attributes | 1(c) Emotion recognition | 2 Critical infrastructure safety component | 3(a) Education access or admission | 3(b) Evaluating learning outcomes | 3(c) Level of education | 3(d) Test monitoring | 4(a) Recruitment and selection | 4(b) Employment decisions and monitoring | 5(a) Public benefits eligibility | 5(b) Creditworthiness or credit scoring | 5(c) Life and health insurance pricing | 5(d) Emergency call triage | 6(a) to 6(e) Law enforcement | 7(a) to 7(d) Migration and border | 8(a) Justice | 8(b) Elections. Default None.

safety_component_article_6_1.description: A safety component of a product covered by Union harmonisation legislation.

exempt_under_article_6_3.description: Falls in Annex III but does not pose significant risk.

transparency_obligation_article_50.description: Interacts with people, or generates synthetic content, deep fakes or emotion recognition.

worldwide_annual_turnover_eur.description: Sets the fine ceiling, which is the greater of the fixed amount and a percentage of turnover.

tools.name: cbam_cost
tools.description: Use it when someone asks: what will CBAM cost me, how much are CBAM certificates, what is the cost of importing steel, aluminium, cement, fertiliser, hydrogen or electricity into the EU, how much in 2027, 2030 or 2034, how much per tonne, what does CBAM add to my landed cost, do I pay CBAM on this shipment, can I deduct the carbon price already paid in the country of origin, what is the free allocation phase-out this year. Computes the certificate cost for any year of the 2026 to 2034 phase-in under Regulation (EU) 2023/956 as amended by 2025/2083, with the phase-out factor from Directive (EU) 2023/959 Article 10a(1a), all six Annex I sectors, a credit for carbon already paid at origin, and the same basket priced in every year to 2034. The phase-in factor changes every year and is the figure most often wrong.

certificate_price_eur.description: CBAM certificate price, which tracks the EU ETS auction price. Required: this server will not invent a market price.

sector.description: One of: Cement | Fertilisers | Iron and steel | Aluminium | Hydrogen | Electricity

tools.name: csrd_scope
tools.description: Use it when someone asks: does CSRD apply to my company, do we have to report under CSRD, are we in scope after the Omnibus, did the postponement take us out of scope, when is our first CSRD report due, which reporting wave are we in, do the 1,000 employee and turnover thresholds catch us, are we a large undertaking, does CSRD apply to a non-EU or US parent with EU subsidiaries, which ESRS standard applies, do we need limited or reasonable assurance, do we have to report for financial year 2026 or 2027. Returns the verdict per financial year under Directive (EU) 2022/2464 as amended by the Stop-the-clock Directive (EU) 2025/794 and Omnibus I Directive (EU) 2026/470, with the size test and the third-country test shown separately.

established_in_eu.description: Is the undertaking established in the EU? Default true. Set false to run the third-country test instead.

employees.description: Average employees during the financial year.

securities_listed_on_an_eu_regulated_mar.description: Listed on an EU regulated market. Default false.

member_state_used_the_postponement_optio.description: Has the Member State used the Omnibus I option for financial years beginning 1 Jan 2025 to 31 Dec 2026? Default false.

group_eu_turnover_eur.description: Third-country test only: group turnover generated in the EU, current year.

group_eu_turnover_prior_year_eur.description: Third-country test only: the same figure for the prior year.

eu_subsidiary_turnover_eur.description: Third-country test only: turnover of the EU subsidiary or branch.

tools.name: compliance_deadlines
tools.description: Use it when someone asks: when is my UAE corporate tax return due, what is the deadline for a financial year ending 31 March or 31 December, when do I have to pay the corporate tax, how many days have I got left, what is the penalty for filing late, when is the first CBAM declaration due, when does the CBAM definitive period start, when do CBAM certificates go on sale, is there still a quarterly CBAM report. Returns the statutory dates for a regime with the Article behind each one, and for UAE Corporate Tax computes the due date from the caller's financial year end. UAE Corporate Tax has no fixed annual deadline, it is nine months after each company's own Tax Period end, and the CBAM dates were rewritten by Regulation (EU) 2025/2083.

financial_year_end.description: For uae_ct, the Tax Period end as YYYY-MM-DD. The due date is computed from it.
